newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chargeurs Intl swings to profit in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Chargeurs Intl swings to profit in 1996.

text.p: Chargeurs International, the textile company created last summer by the de-merger of conglomerate Chargeurs, said on Wednesday it returned to the black last year.
Chargeurs International reported a 136 million franc profit for 1996, compared with a 65 million franc loss for the previous year despite a fall in turnover to 8.67 billion francs from 8.82 billion.
The company said it expected improved results in 1997 barring unforeseen changes in the economic environment.

"The group is pursuing the vigorous recovery plan for its wool activities, helped since the start of the year by favourable wool prices and by orders higher than those at the end of February 1996," it said in a statement.

"The monetary context is favourable for the whole of the group's activities. Barring a change in this environment, Chargeurs International should continue the improvement in its results in 1997 while stressing international development," it said.
Its shares were unchanged at midday at 324 francs.
